newsitem.title: FINLAND: THIN HELSINKI DOWN, CAUTIOUS OF US POST-DATA YO-YO.
newsitem.headline: THIN HELSINKI DOWN, CAUTIOUS OF US POST-DATA YO-YO.

text.p: Shares were down in very thin early trade as Nokia matched its lower Wall Street close and UPM dipped after reporting in-line H1 results.
UPM's profit -- at 3.53 billion markka up 70 percent, boosted by asset sales -- was near the top-end of analysts' forecasts in a Reuters poll.

"It seems that the first figure... should have been different for UPM to have gained," a broker said. After its initial 2.00 markka fall to 140.00, UPM would now trade with the rest of the market, another broker said.
Brokers said investors were cautious ahead of U.S. July CPI.
"After the data yesterday, the (U.S.) markets and the dollar went up and down. There is caution here now," one broker said.
U.S. July PPI and retail sales data reported on Wednesday came in lower than expected. The average forecast for U.S. July CPI due at 1530/1230 GMT is fot a 0.2 percent rise on June.
Amer bucked the trend, rising 1.80 markka to 101.00.
"There is no new information, or even rumours," one broker said.
